{"rule": "Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and a new passage of about 250 words in the text field.", "text": "She did not sleep. She sat in his chair with the notebook on her knee and the set humming in front of her, and at some point the window went from black to grey without her noticing the change.

In the morning she walked down to the harbour. The boat was still there, tied where he had left it, and the tide had gone out and come back in under it without asking anyone's permission. She stood on the slip for a while. A man she half recognised raised a hand from the fuel pump and she raised one back, and neither of them came closer.

At the shop she bought bread and batteries and a new pencil. The woman behind the counter said she was sorry, and then said he had been a quiet one, hadn't he, and she agreed that he had. She did not say that he had also been a precise one. That nineteen years of eleven minutes was not quiet. That it was the loudest thing she had ever been handed.

Walking back up the hill she found herself doing the arithmetic. Nineteen years. Three hundred and sixty-five nights, give or take. Almost seven thousand entries in the same cramped hand, and not one of them explained.

She thought about the cross on the chart. Forty miles. The boat could do it in a day if the weather held.

She put the bread away and the batteries in the drawer and sharpened the pencil, and then she took the chart down off the wall and spread it flat on the table, and began, very carefully, to measure."}
